name: Concordia
tagline: A city of a million, turning at L5
author: David Veksler
summary: Concordia is the first fifth-generation space habitat: four rotating cities, a partial-gravity industrial rotor, a shipyard and a spaceport strung along a 21 km axis at the Earth-Moon L5 region, home to about 400,000 people and built for a million. This site is its visitor guide and engineering primer, written as if it were 2045, with a live three-dimensional simulation you can walk through. The physics is real and the numbers come from the project's engineering specification; the 2045 history is a speculative design.
